beats.text: Chain rule. Bracket to a power. Watch the pen, this takes thirty seconds.
We're given y equals two x plus one, all to the power five.
Bracket to a power? Let u be the inside. So y is just u to the five.
Differentiate each part. dy by du is five u to the power four. du by dx is two.
Chain rule: multiply them. Then put the inside back.
So dy by dx is ten, times two x plus one, to the power four.
That multiply step is the chain rule. Every time. Follow for the next one.
